$comment: Copy this file to cc.config.json and edit it.
Every field is optional: missing values fall back to safe defaults, so you can
also run with no config file at all and configure everything from the UI.
Environment variables override this file (see README: Configuration).
Relative paths are resolved against the project root.
$comment_workspace: The directory agents are told to work in (their cwd).
Use an absolute path, or leave it out to default to the process cwd.
$comment_auth: A shared token is generated on first run into data/.token and printed at startup.
Open http://host:port/?token=<token> once; the browser keeps a cookie afterwards.
Set CC_TOKEN to pin your own token, or set auth=false ONLY on a trusted machine.
$comment_permissionMode: Sandbox mode handed to DSH member processes.
danger-full-access = full permissions (shell, full-text search, writes outside workspace).
workspace-write   = members may only write inside the workspace; shell/search fail.
This only affects agents launched by the command center, not your own DSH session.
$comment_dsh: DeepSeek Harness CLI (optional). Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH;
if it is not installed, CLI-based DSH members are simply unavailable and
API-based members keep working. Set dshCli to a .cmd/.bat on Windows or a
shell script on macOS/Linux and the launcher will figure out the real binary.
$comment_backends: Optional parameters per CLI backend. Paths are auto-detected when empty.
claudeUseProxy: true when talking to the official Anthropic endpoint, false for
claudeEnv: extra environment variables for the Claude CLI.
API keys never go here: they live in secrets.json (gitignored) or data/.
concurrency: how many turns may run at the same time (global), see queue.mjs.
$comment_limits: turnTimeoutMs: hard timeout per member turn (default 30 min).
maxConcurrentTurns: global cap for parallel member turns (default 4).
perMemberQueue: one turn at a time per member (default true).
